organization.name: BambooHR
organization.notes: Company founded by Ben Peterson and Ryan Sanders in 2008. Official FAQ explicitly confirms privately held. Sorenson Capital lists BambooHR in its portfolio; financing amount and current stake not established. Other secondary investor claims excluded.

pricingTiers.name: Core (25 employees or fewer)
pricingTiers.notes: Official FAQ flat monthly price for <=25 employees; month-to-month terms available. >25 employee Core headline $10 conflicts with FAQ $10.25/employee/month; larger-company rate withheld. Add-ons extra.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Pro (25 employees or fewer)
pricingTiers.notes: Closest expanded organization plan. <=25 employees flat monthly price. >25 Pro headline $17 conflicts with FAQ $17.50/employee/month; larger-company rate withheld.

pricingTiers.name: Elite (25 employees or fewer)
pricingTiers.notes: Highest plan mapped to enterprise role; no separately named Enterprise plan. <=25 employees flat monthly price; >25 employees advertised $25/employee/month. Payroll/benefits/time add-ons extra.

moats.claim: A unified employee record spanning hiring, time off, compensation and reporting can make mature HR workflows costly to migrate.

productReasons.claim: Employee records, custom reporting and approvals connect HR data to day-to-day information changes.
Candidate records, posting and offer templates keep hiring activity close to employee onboarding.
Elite compensation planning, salary bands and Mercer benchmarks support structured pay reviews.
